Name: representative_entry_pdb_id
Description: PDB entry containing the protein-cluster representative; together with representative_chain_asym_id identifies the cluster

Name: representative_chain_asym_id
Description: Source label_asym_id of the protein-cluster representative; missing when the chain could not be clustered

Name: is_representative
Description: Whether this protein chain is its cluster representative; missing when the chain could not be clustered

Name: status
Description: Protein clustering outcome: clustered, missing_sequence (MMseqs), or insufficient_coordinates (Foldseek)
